verdict.rationale: E2B documents some first-party bulk operations: writing multiple files to a sandbox in one call, shutting down all running sandboxes at once from the CLI, and listing sandboxes filtered by running or paused state. These are narrow, specific cases rather than a general bulk-operations capability. Missing for 10: general batch operations across many sandboxes (e.g. bulk pause/resume, bulk command execution, bulk snapshot), bulk APIs in the SDK beyond multi-file write, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
